label: Video Call (Zoom-style meeting)
description: A Zoom-style meeting in progress: two participant tiles with alternating active-speaker glow and animated speaking waveforms, meeting chrome (Recording pill, toolbar, timer), an optional caption line, and an AI notetaker bot tile (Fathom-style) with a pulsing REC badge docked in the grid. Use for 'the story starts on a call' beats: sales calls, demos, customer conversations that a recorder is capturing. Script it so the call is alive: speakers alternate, a caption or two lands, the recorder pulses when the story points at it.

title.label: Meeting title shown in the top bar (e.g. 'Demo — BrightLoop x Quotient')

participants.label: Two participants: {name, avatar_url?, initials?}. Without avatar_url a premium initials tile renders.

recorder.label: Notetaker bot tile: {name ('Fathom Notetaker'), icon_url?, status ('Recording')}. Defaults to Fathom.

timer.label: Meeting elapsed time shown in the toolbar (e.g. '31:42')

first_speaker.label: Index (0/1) of the participant speaking at scene start

script.label: Timed actions: set-speaker {index, at}, show-caption {text, speaker?, label?, at, duration} (label overrides the bold CC attribution, e.g. 'Customer'), pulse-recorder {at}. Plus shared cursor actions.
